page_title: ROM 2-0 UDI | AS Roma v Udinese 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Giuseppe Collu is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
90+2' A quickly taken corner by Udinese.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) replacing Wesley Franca.
90' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Zeki Celik.
88' What a chance that is! Arthur Atta (Udinese) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
87' The corner from Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) is intercepted by the defence.
86' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

85' Mile Svilar pulls off a brilliant save! Matteo Palma (Udinese) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved. The ball goes out of play and Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
82' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Hassane Kamara will be replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
82' That's the end of the game for Nicolo Zaniolo, who is replaced by Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese).
81' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

79' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Maduka Okoye blocks the shot with his legs.
78' The resulting corner, taken by Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma), comes to nothing.
78' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) inside the box following a slide rule pass. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Matias Soule will be replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) for Lorenzo Pellegrini.
72' Lovely run from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
72' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Keinan Davis (Udinese) replaces Adam Buksa.
72' A substitution has been made. Jesper Karlstrom goes off and Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) comes on.
70' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

70' A cross by Hassane Kamara (Udinese) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
65' Wonderful movement by Udinese. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
62' What was Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
61' 2 - 0 Goal Zeki Celik (AS Roma)! Zeki Celik (AS Roma) was put through by Gianluca Mancini and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.

60' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) can't believe his eyes as he blows an opportunity from close range. It looked really simple and he only needed to tap the ball in, but he failed. The ball goes well wide of the right post. Hang your head in shame son.
60' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
55' The corner from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is cleared away by the defence.

54' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
53' Matteo Palma (Udinese) comes onto the pitch because Christian Kabasele simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
51' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Adam Buksa (Udinese) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Mile Svilar easily catches the ball.
48' Oumar Solet (Udinese) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
46' Referee Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) picks up a yellow card.
45+4' Giuseppe Collu blows the whistle, Manu Kone (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Wow, what an escape. Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
43' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch after Artem Dovbyk signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
42' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Maduka Okoye no chance!
42' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
41' It’s a PENALTY to AS Roma after the VAR review!
39' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for AS Roma! Let's see what he decides.
39' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
36' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
36' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Mile Svilar was alert and made a comfortable save.
34' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the left post.
30' He should have scored! Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
28' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
26' Arthur Atta (Udinese) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post.

23' What a chance that is! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post!

21' Chance! Wesley Franca sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Zeki Celik (AS Roma), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.

19' AS Roma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
15' Adam Buksa (Udinese) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Hassane Kamara.
13' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Wesley Franca (AS Roma).
10' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
7' Matias Soule (AS Roma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
6' The free kick is taken by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), but ball is cleared.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Giuseppe Collu.
